options.content:
### Prometheus · Overview
SLIs scrape_success_ratio, wal_corruption_freshness, rule_evaluation_success_ratio, query_latency_p99 · SLOs scrape_success_99_9, rule_evaluation_99_95.  ·  pack `prometheus@1.0.0`  ·  **Overview** · [Query engine](/d/prometheus-query-engine?${__url_time_range}) · [Tsdb health](/d/prometheus-tsdb-health?${__url_time_range}) · [Slo burn](/d/prometheus-slo-burn?${__url_time_range})

panels.title: Scrape success
panels.description: Fraction of scrape attempts that succeeded (target up == 1). SLO 99.9 % over 30d.

panels.title: Wal corruption freshness
panels.description: Fraction of WAL corruption events per total WAL operations. Healthy Prometheus instances should have ZERO WAL corruptions across any window. Non-zero values indicate disk faults. SLO 99.99 % over 30d.

panels.title: Rule evaluation success
panels.description: Fraction of recording / alerting rule evaluations that succeeded vs. attempted. SLO 99.95 % over 30d.

panels.title: Query latency p99
panels.description: 99th-percentile query duration (PromQL queries via /api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range). SLO 99 % over 30d.

panels.title: Error-budget burn · last hour
panels.description: 1 h error-budget burn rate per SLO: 1× consumes the budget exactly over the SLO window; amber at the smallest factor that alerts for that SLO, red at the largest (spec.policy).

panels.title: Burn rate · 5 m window
panels.description: Fast window: reacts within minutes; pages when both it and the slow window exceed the factor. Hover for per-SLO values.

panels.title: Burn rate · 1 h window
panels.description: Slow window: keeps burning for up to an hour after an incident by design.

panels.title: Last certification
panels.description: Verdict of the last `npm run certify` published to the alert-sink: PASS, WARN, FAIL or ERROR.

panels.title: Certified
panels.description: When the last certification run finished.

panels.title: MTTD p50
panels.description: Median time from fault injection to the alert webhook, across every expected alert of the chaos suite. Baseline p50 2 min (pack spec.baselines).

panels.title: MTTD p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to detect. Baseline p95 5 min.

panels.title: MTTR p50 · resolution
panels.description: Median time from the recovery action to the resolved webhook: the observability system's share of MTTR (it excludes the human/automation fix time). Baseline MTTR p50 30 min.

panels.title: MTTR p95 · resolution
panels.description: 95th percentile resolution after recovery. Baseline MTTR p95 60 min.

panels.title: MTTD per expected alert · against its budget
panels.description: Time from injection to the firing webhook for each expected alert in the last run; amber from 75 % of the experiment's expected_mttd, red at the budget.

panels.title: Resolution after recovery · per alert
panels.description: Time from the recovery action to the resolved webhook in the last run (Prometheus resolve + Alertmanager group_interval + webhook).

panels.title: Conformance passed
panels.description: C1-C10: does the stack implement the pack?

panels.title: Synthetic passed
panels.description: S1-S6: canary, orders flow, no symptom or fast-window burn alert firing.

panels.title: Chaos passed
panels.description: Experiments whose alerts fired within budget, resolved after recovery, and whose hypothesis SLI moved as declared.

panels.title: Webhooks in the ledger
panels.description: Alertmanager webhook events held by the alert-sink (MTTD is measured from their receipt time).

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", pack="prometheus", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Symptom alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: State of every symptom alert of the pack over the time range.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", burn_rate="", kind=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")

panels.title: Firing pack alerts
panels.description: Everything currently firing with the pack label, most severe first.

panels.title: Burn-rate & forecast alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: Multi-window burn-rate alerts (fast windows page, slow windows linger after incidents) and forecasts.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", burn_rate!=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", burn_rate!=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")
(2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", kind="forecast"})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", kind="forecast"})

options.content:
| Trigger | Runbook | Automation (declared) | Guardrails (declared) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prometheus-scrape-failures-burn` | `runbooks/scrape-failures.md` | `restart-failing-scrapers` | ≤ 2/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 15m |
| `prometheus-rule-eval-failures-burn` | `runbooks/rule-evaluation-failures.md` | `reload-prometheus-config` | ≤ 3/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 10m |
| `prometheus-tsdb-compaction-failures` | `runbooks/tsdb-compaction.md` | `trigger-manual-compaction` | ≤ 1/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 1h |
| `prometheus-wal-corruption` | `runbooks/wal-corruption.md` | `manual-only` | ≤ 1/h · human above SEV1 |

<small>Automations and guardrails come from the pack's `remediation` section for the platform to implement; in this lab every action is done by hand, as the runbooks say.</small>

panels.title: TSDB series
panels.description: Active series in the metrics store.

panels.title: Recording rules producing
panels.description: Distinct prometheus:* recording-rule series currently produced (pack queries + generated error-budget rules).

panels.title: Scrape duration by job
panels.description: The pack's scrape jobs: prometheus-self.

panels.title: Collector · exported per second
panels.description: OpenTelemetry Collector export throughput (present when the pack pipeline runs through a collector).

panels.title: Collector · export failures per second
panels.description: The failure counters only exist once a batch has failed; a flat zero is the collector saying nothing has.

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Traces whose resource is the prometheus service.
